name: fruteria-pos
description: Punto de Venta local-first para frutería y abarrotes (peso y piezas)

scripts.seed: npm run db:push -w server && npm run seed -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,currency -c green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w currency-service"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w currency-service
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client && npm run test -w currency-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w currency-service
